research_question: Can DICE's Human Validation validate reusable Interpretation Patterns / Capability Boundaries, rather than degrading to instance-by-instance annotation?

current_architecture_inventory.validation_object_actual: instance-level (ValidationTask keyed by observation_id + document_id + page_number)
current_architecture_inventory.validation_record_saves: verdict (ACCEPT/REJECT/NEED_REVIEW) + reason + notes + timestamp + duration + reviewer_id + revision_status + supersedes + provenance — NO pattern/negative-set/boundary/scope fields
current_architecture_inventory.reusable_pattern_expression: ABSENT — no schema, no object, no process
current_architecture_inventory.human_review_ui_instance_bias: PRESENT — review_interface presents one candidate at a time (index/total), Accept/Reject/Need Review per candidate
current_architecture_inventory.instance_level_bias_location: ValidationTask key construction (document|page|observation_id) + review_interface per-candidate presentation loop
current_architecture_inventory.frozen_capability_table: 22 static DICE 1.0 capabilities; L3_SKILL_ROUTES = human-authored static mapping, NOT auto-learned, NOT derived from validation
current_architecture_inventory.table_tablecell_in_p71: BLOCKED (structure_config: 'waits for Table Cell Geometry observation') — EIC-1 cell-context candidate has NO corresponding hypothesis type in frozen P7.1/P7.2
current_architecture_inventory.eic1_sce_home: tmp/ experimental artifact only; no architecture归宿 in P7.1/P7.2

authority_ladder: Human Validation (L5 currently=instance verdict; design target=pattern validation)
authority_principle: higher semantic authority requires stronger evidence + stronger validation; L4 not auto-L5; L5 not auto-L6

D_interpretation_pattern.verdict: MOST EVIDENCE-SUPPORTED — DESIGN CONCLUSION not implementation

E_capability_boundary.verdict: premature — downstream of D; cannot jump without D; overreach risk HIGH

candidate_evaluation.why_others_insufficient: A/B = instance labeling anti-pattern (no reuse, burden scales, no negative/boundary); C = instance-bound with extra chain; E = premature without D

feasibility_check_with_real_cases.pattern_covers: AMB-135 + 6 DIRECT (130/457/467/483/505/514) + 8 controls = ~15 instances per 1 pattern validation
feasibility_check_with_real_cases.feasibility: YES — 1 pattern ~15 instances; human burden 1 vs 15
feasibility_check_with_real_cases.caveat: GT-confirmed positive=1; positive diversity insufficient; pattern generalization NOT verified (framework only)

anti_pattern_audit.evidence: no structured negative set in schema
NEED_REVIEW exists but per-instance not pattern-level

human_burden_model.model: Many Instances -> Repeated Evidence Pattern -> One Human Validation -> Reusable Pattern -> Many New Instances
human_burden_model.one_validation_covers_many_when: instances share same structural configuration (same EIC-1 preconditions)
human_burden_model.cannot_when: instances have different structures (caption vs table vs code)
human_burden_model.retain_unknown_when: evidence insufficient to form pattern (positive diversity=1)
human_burden_model.not_worth_abstracting_when: pattern covers only 1 instance (no reuse benefit)

pattern_validation_vs_capability.flow: Pattern Validation -> Validated Knowledge/Interpretation -> Capability Candidate -> Human Controlled Registration -> Capability
pattern_validation_vs_capability.frozen_capability_table_nature: static DICE 1.0 human-authored routing, NOT derived from pattern validation
pattern_validation_vs_capability.new_capability_requires: pattern validated -> capability candidate proposed -> human registration decision -> capability table entry (governed, non-automatic)

paper_value_assessment.topic: Human Validation as reusable pattern validation

final_judgments.A_reason: pattern ingredients 5/10 ready from M-B; pattern object/schema/abstraction layer ABSENT in current architecture (grep 0); ValidationTask structurally instance-level; 4 anti-pattern risks PRESENT; TABLE/TABLE_CELL BLOCKED in P7.1 (EIC-1 candidate has no architecture home); design work required before any L5 validation
final_judgments.B_minimal_research_object: Interpretation Pattern (Candidate D) — most evidence-supported; DESIGN CONCLUSION not implementation decision; 5/10 components ready, 5/10 need design; does not jump to E (capability boundary) as premature
final_judgments.C_reason: existing frozen Observation (P1/P2 geometry + Atomic Observation) sufficient to express all pattern prerequisites (M-B Expressability Audit + Phase 3.2 proven); gap is pattern abstraction layer + human validation process, not observation
